agent_report.summary: Merged PR #13 after verifying it satisfies all 13 acceptance criteria of Issue #12 (code, tests, and both CI screenshots checked; Codex raised no findings). The branch was behind main, so I updated it and waited for CI to go green again before squash-merging, as auto-merge is disabled on this repo. Issue #12 is now closed and work in flight dropped to 0, so I created the single most useful next Issue, #14: day navigation and a week strip. It makes the selected day first-class state, which is also the root-cause fix for the midnight-rollover defect I found in app.js, and unlocks day navigation, week awareness and history access from GOAL.md. I decided two design questions inside the Issue (past days stay editable; the app always opens on today) rather than leaving them open. Weekly goals, commitments and deadlines remain unimplemented, so the project is not DONE.
